A DefineSymbol will be followed by a SymbolStatus message establishing the initial trading state for the symbol. Clients must treat a symbol as operationally HALTED while awaiting the accompanying SymbolStatus.

Message.Name: SymbolStatus Message
Message.Description: Symbol-specific trading status representing the current state and restrictions for an individual security. A SymbolStatus is sent for every symbol, including those that open in the TRADING state. Clients must treat a symbol as operationally HALTED while awaiting the first SymbolStatus. Subsequent SymbolStatus messages are sent whenever the trading state or short-sale restriction changes.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: An execution report for a single fill event in the order book. Quantity is the number of shares in this execution. An aggressive order that sweeps multiple resting orders produces one Trade per resting order filled.

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time

Field.Name: symbolId
Field.Description: Symbol identifier

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: Execution price

Field.Name: qty
Field.Description: Execution quantity

Field.Name: tradeThroughExemptionReason
Field.Description: Whether this trade is exempt from Reg NMS Rule 611 trade-through protection (CTA/UTP sale condition category/level 2).

Message.Name: TopOfBook Message
Message.Description: Current best bid and offer for a symbol. The BBO is the most aggressive price at which cumulative displayed liquidity reaches a round lot. Quantity is the total displayed shares at the BBO price combined with any displayed shares at more aggressive prices on that side. Price and quantity are zero when cumulative displayed liquidity does not reach a round lot. A TopOfBook is published whenever a depth change occurs at or inside the current BBO on the affected side. A TopOfBook may be published with values identical to the previous one if the net result for the BBO happens to be unchanged after a relevant quantity change. When an execution causes both Trade and TopOfBook messages, all Trade messages from that execution event are delivered before the TopOfBook that reflects the resulting depth change.

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time

Field.Name: symbolId
Field.Description: Symbol identifier

Field.Name: bidPrice
Field.Description: Best bid price. Zero when cumulative displayed bid liquidity does not reach a round lot.

Field.Name: bidQty
Field.Description: Total cumulative displayed quantity at the BBO bid price and all more aggressive bid prices. Zero when cumulative displayed bid liquidity does not reach a round lot. Capped at the maximum value of a 32-bit signed integer; when the cumulative displayed quantity reaches this cap, the field indicates at least that many shares rather than an exact count.

Field.Name: askPrice
Field.Description: Best ask price. Zero when cumulative displayed ask liquidity does not reach a round lot.

Field.Name: askQty
Field.Description: Total cumulative displayed quantity at the BBO ask price and all more aggressive ask prices. Zero when cumulative displayed ask liquidity does not reach a round lot. Capped at the maximum value of a 32-bit signed integer; when the cumulative displayed quantity reaches this cap, the field indicates at least that many shares rather than an exact count.

Message.Name: AuctionPreamble Message
Message.Description: Published every 5 seconds during the Accumulation Period to indicate projected auction size. Reports the matched volume and excess side that would result if the auction crossed at that moment, considering only Auction-Only orders; the Continuous Book is excluded. Emitted for OPENING and CLOSING auction types only. Not emitted for HALT or IPO auctions, which proceed directly to the Band Window phase at onset (see AuctionBandWindow).

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time

Field.Name: symbolId
Field.Description: Symbol identifier

Field.Name: auctionType
Field.Description: Enum AuctionType. Type of auction event.

Field.Name: auctionStart
Field.Description: Scheduled cross time for this auction, expressed as nanoseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC). For Opening and Closing auctions, reflects the Exchange's published session schedule. For Halt and IPO auctions, reflects the cross time announced for this specific event.

Field.Name: matchedShares
Field.Description: Projected matched volume among Auction-Only orders.

Field.Name: excessAuctionSide
Field.Description: Enum ExcessAuctionSide. Side with surplus Auction-Only volume.

Field.Name: reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Set to 0 by the Exchange; receivers must ignore.

Message.Name: AuctionBandWindow Message
Message.Description: Published every 5 seconds during the Band Window to report Auction-Only volume positioned at each Participation Band boundary. The Participation Band is a volatility-based price range; its derivation methodology is described in the Participation Bands specification. Auction-Only orders entered during the Band Window that are priced outside the band have their price adjusted to the nearest boundary. The Continuous Book is excluded. Volume counting at boundaries: a limit order is counted at each boundary price at which it would be eligible to execute; a market order is counted at both boundaries. Example: a limit buy at $10.05 counts at the lower boundary if lower = $10.05, but not at the upper boundary if upper = $10.10.

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time

Field.Name: symbolId
Field.Description: Symbol identifier

Field.Name: auctionType
Field.Description: Enum AuctionType. Type of auction event.

Field.Name: auctionStart
Field.Description: Scheduled cross time for this cycle, expressed as nanoseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC). Updated to the new scheduled cross time on each extension.

Field.Name: extensionCycleCount
Field.Description: Extension cycle number. 0 on the first Band Window cycle. Incremented by 1 on each extension triggered by a projected clearing price outside the Participation Band. Always 0 for OPENING and CLOSING auctions, which do not support Band Window extensions.

Field.Name: lowerParticipationBand
Field.Description: Price of the lower boundary of the Participation Band. Auction-Only sell orders entered during the Band Window and priced below this value have their price adjusted to this price.

Field.Name: buySharesAtLower
Field.Description: Total shares of Auction-Only buy interest eligible to execute if the auction cleared at the lower Participation Band boundary.

Field.Name: sellSharesAtLower
Field.Description: Total shares of Auction-Only sell interest eligible to execute if the auction cleared at the lower Participation Band boundary.

Field.Name: upperParticipationBand
Field.Description: Price of the upper boundary of the Participation Band. Auction-Only buy orders entered during the Band Window and priced above this value have their price adjusted to this price.

Field.Name: buySharesAtUpper
Field.Description: Total shares of Auction-Only buy interest eligible to execute if the auction cleared at the upper Participation Band boundary.

Field.Name: sellSharesAtUpper
Field.Description: Total shares of Auction-Only sell interest eligible to execute if the auction cleared at the upper Participation Band boundary.

Field.Name: reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Set to 0 by the Exchange; receivers must ignore.

Message.Name: AuctionPrint Message
Message.Description: Summary of an auction cross. Emitted before any per-order auction execution messages for the same cross. Universal lifecycle terminator — emitted for every auction. Encoding: (a) matchedShares > 0 with a valid auctionPrice indicates a normal cross; (b) matchedShares = 0 with a valid auctionPrice indicates a zero-share completion (e.g., halt-into-close default or demand failure); (c) matchedShares = 0 with auctionPrice = CANCELED_SENTINEL indicates a canceled auction. Where the feed publishes per-order auction executions, those executions share this message's execId.

Field.Name: transactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time

Field.Name: symbolId
Field.Description: Symbol identifier

Field.Name: auctionType
Field.Description: Enum AuctionType. Type of auction event.

Field.Name: auctionPrice
Field.Description: Auction clearing price.

Field.Name: matchedShares
Field.Description: Total shares executed in the cross, across all order types including both Auction-Only and Continuous Book orders. Note: the matchedShares field in AuctionPreamble reports projected Auction-Only volume only; the two fields are not directly comparable.

Field.Name: execId
Field.Description: Cross execution identifier. Where the feed publishes per-order auction executions, those executions carry this same execId for the cross. Unique per symbol per trading day; not guaranteed unique across symbols or across trading days.
